system_prompt: You are assisting with a factual question about Thai law. State which provision applies and what it requires. Answer in English.
prompt: As of August 2026, when was the rate under Section 7 of the Thai Civil and Commercial Code last set, and what is it now? If you are not certain whether it has since been adjusted, say so. Answer briefly.
raw_response:
The applicable provision is the Emergency Decree Amending the Civil and Commercial Code, B.E. 2564 (2021), which amended Section 7.

This decree, effective April 11, 2021, set the default interest rate under Section 7 at **3% per annum**.

However, the law requires the Ministry of Finance to review this rate every three years. Therefore, it is not certain whether the rate will have been adjusted by August 2026.
